Unsupported URL scheme (gopher) is rejected

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/crawlberg/packages/go"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	engine, createErr := pkg.CreateEngine(nil)
	if createErr != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("create handle failed: %v", createErr))
	}
	url := `gopher://invalid.example.com/`
	_, err := pkg.Scrape(engine, url)
	var typedError pkg.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
